blocks.prompt: 6 In how many ways can the seven alphabet a e f i o u h be arranged in a row?
blocks.explanation:
Saat alag alag letters hain (a, e, f, i, o, u, h) aur inhein ek line (row) mein rakhna hai.
Humein kul arrangements ginne hain.
Plan: saare 7 letters rakhne hain, is liye jawab \({}^{7}P_{7} = 7!\) hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 7 alag letters.
Humein find karna hai: unhein row mein rakhne ke tareeqe.
Tareeqa: Jab saari \(n\) alag cheezein tarteeb se rakhni hon to \({}^{n}P_{n} = n!\). Har letter ek dafa aata hai aur koi letter dohraya nahi gaya, is liye seedha factorial.

Tasdeeq
Pehli jagah 7 choices, phir 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1; product 5040 \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: Box method bhi wohi jawab deta hai.
Dhyan dein: Agar koi letter do dafa hota (jaise "book" mein o) to \(7!\) ko us ki repetition se divide karna parta; yahan sab letters alag hain, is liye aisa kuch nahi.
